name: What types of bathroom sinks can be installed?

mainEntity.name: What types of bathroom sinks can be installed?

acceptedAnswer.text: Bathroom sinks come in various styles, including pedestal, wall-mounted, drop-in, undermount, vessel, and integrated. The best type for your bathroom often depends on your existing vanity configuration, plumbing rough-ins, and aesthetic preferences. For example, a vessel sink requires specific countertop clearance and faucet height, while an undermount sink offers easier countertop cleaning but needs a compatible countertop material.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common types include pedestal, wall-mounted, drop-in, undermount, vessel, and integrated sinks, each suiting different bathroom designs and plumbing setups.
